name: Black Heritage Gospel Choir - The Soul of Gospel
description: The Black Heritage Choir, featuring voices from the Mississippi Mass Choir and directed by Jerry Calvin Smith, presents "The Soul of Gospel". This concert explores the history of gospel music, from its origins in the American South to its modern expressions.
longDescription:
The Black Heritage Gospel Choir performs "The Soul of Gospel" at Vilar Oporto Hotel in Porto on December 12, 2026, starting at 21:00. The show runs for 90 minutes, with doors opening at 20:00. The choir includes vocalists from the Mississippi Mass Choir and is led by Jerry Calvin Smith.

The performance traces the evolution of gospel music, covering its historical roots in the southern United States and its contemporary forms. The concert is known for its energetic delivery, musical precision, and authentic sound, aiming to connect with audiences through its blend of tradition and modernity.

Tickets are available in several categories: Plateia VIP for €50, 1ª Plateia for €40, and 2ª Plateia and 3ª Plateia for €35 each. The event is suitable for ages 6 and up, with entry permitted for children aged 3 and above.

A atuação traça a evolução da música gospel, cobrindo as suas raízes históricas no sul dos Estados Unidos e as suas formas contemporâneas. O concerto é conhecido pela sua energia, precisão musical e som autêntico, procurando ligar-se ao público através da sua mistura de tradição e modernidade.

Os bilhetes estão disponíveis em várias categorias: Plateia VIP por 50€, 1ª Plateia por 40€, e 2ª Plateia e 3ª Plateia por 35€ cada. O evento é adequado para maiores de 6 anos, com entrada permitida para crianças a partir dos 3 anos.
